{
  "skills": [
    {
      "skill_id": "rigid_scaffold_size_inverted_solubility_transfer",
      "rules": [
        {
          "rule_id": "long_smiles_large_apolar_volume_reward",
          "conditions": {"smiles_length_bin": "smiles_long"},
          "weight": 0.5,
          "rationale": "Source solubility effect for smiles_long was strongly negative; lipophilicity opposes solubility, so large molecular volume should raise logD."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "fused_aromatic_ring_surface_reward",
          "conditions": {"ring_token_bin": "ring_token_high", "aromatic_bin": "aromatic_high"},
          "weight": 0.55,
          "rationale": "Ring-dense aromatic scaffolds present large polarizable hydrophobic surface with low hydration cost, the classic high-logD signature."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "flexible_acyclic_branch_hydration_penalty",
          "conditions": {"branch_bin": "branch_high", "ring_token_bin": "ring_token_low"},
          "weight": -0.55,
          "rationale": "Acyclic heavily branched skeletons carry exposed flexible polar substituents that hydrate readily, lowering partition coefficient."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "moderate_halogenation_boost",
          "conditions": {"halogen_bin": "halogen_mid"},
          "weight": 0.35,
          "rationale": "Halogens add polarizable apolar volume without hydrogen-bond donors, consistently increasing measured logD."
        }
      ],
      "ridge": 1.5,
      "prior_scale": 0.3,
      "semantic_mass_start": 0.38,
      "semantic_mass_end": 0.12,
      "ucb_weight": 0.55,
      "gp_beta_start": 2.2,
      "gp_beta_end": 1.1,
      "gp_xi": 0.02,
      "confidence": 0.66,
      "hypothesis": "Ring-dense aromatic, size-large, branch-poor scaffolds mark high lipophilicity, treating the source solubility length effect as sign-inverted. It may fail if large scaffolds are heteroatom-saturated or if short compact halogenated molecules dominate the top tail."
    },
    {
      "skill_id": "polarity_inventory_counter_hypothesis_no_scaffold_transfer",
      "rules": [
        {
          "rule_id": "hetero_low_carbon_rich_reward",
          "conditions": {"hetero_atom_bin": "hetero_low"},
          "weight": 0.7,
          "rationale": "Low heteroatom inventory means minimal hydrogen bonding and desolvation cost, the dominant mechanistic driver of high logD."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "hetero_high_broad_polarity_penalty",
          "conditions": {"hetero_atom_bin": "hetero_high"},
          "weight": -0.35,
          "rationale": "Dense polar atoms add hydration sites; penalty applied broadly without conditioning on ring scaffold."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "aromatic_without_carbonyl_reward",
          "conditions": {"aromatic_bin": "aromatic_high", "double_bond_bin": "double_bond_none"},
          "weight": 0.4,
          "rationale": "Aromatic systems lacking explicit double bonds usually lack carbonyl or nitro groups, so hydrophobic surface stays unmasked."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "heavy_halogenation_reward",
          "conditions": {"halogen_bin": "halogen_high"},
          "weight": 0.45,
          "rationale": "Multiple halogens strongly increase apolar polarizable volume and shield polar centers, raising partitioning."
        }
      ],
      "ridge": 2.5,
      "prior_scale": 0.25,
      "semantic_mass_start": 0.3,
      "semantic_mass_end": 0.1,
      "ucb_weight": 0.6,
      "gp_beta_start": 2.0,
      "gp_beta_end": 1.0,
      "gp_xi": 0.01,
      "confidence": 0.55,
      "hypothesis": "Counter-hypothesis: the uncertain ring_bin and rotatable_bond_bin transfers are solubility-specific, so scaffold terms are dropped and polarity plus halogenation alone drive logD. It may fail if polar groups are intramolecularly shielded."
    }
  ],
  "selected_skill_id": "rigid_scaffold_size_inverted_solubility_transfer",
  "lesson": "On development seeds the scaffold/flexibility skill led the polarity-penalty skill (86.9 vs 84.5 mean AUC), so scaffold rigidity plus size, with solubility effects read as sign-inverted, is the better working
